model: Weak-gravity Maxwell path bending added to magnetic-current path feedback

parameters.separation_convention: Fixed once so the prior single-delay1.2 corresponds to the shortest leading path in its old leading clock; not a measured or solved physical separation

equations.units: All coordinates use separation d. epsilon=m/d; b=delta f/epsilon=delta physical_length/m. a=R_isotropic/d is fixed during the epsilon derivative.
equations.direct: b_cut=2[integral_0^sc partial_epsilon(speed) ds+speed(sc)*partial_epsilon(sc)]. The last term is the moving integration limit; 2E instead includes the entire endpoint work in the curvature formula.
equations.limit: b_cut-b_point=-nu*(2-nu)*a^4+O_nu(a^5). Each removed curvature cap contributes -(3/2)nu*(2-nu)*a^4; each endpoint work is -2nu*(2-nu)*a^4.

finite_cut_checks.scope: Only fixed global isotropic spheres in the selected weak-gravity point-source field model. The small-cut expansion is checked at the listed fixed flux labels, not a uniform physical-interface error bound. No actual throat continuation, mouth displacement, clock matching or finite-q state is supplied; the existing optical/Shapiro contribution is not added again.

causality_scope.assumed_time: Static lapse N>0 and a single globally shared time t, with no temporal mouth identification offset.
causality_scope.time_function: g_inverse(dt,dt)=−1/N²<0. Future causal curves have increasing t, so this assumed static construction cannot yield backward travel.
causality_scope.implication: Small static source/path corrections alone do not introduce the relative mouth-time offset required by a chronology-changing proposal. Existence and stability of a physical matched metric remain unproved.

matching_sensitivity.convention: eta is an independent log shift of the clock converting exterior lengths into throat time; theta is an independent added throat optical time, both at fixed mean state. delta w=combined_selected_shift+C_eta*eta+C_theta*theta. They are not selected physical data. The mean-state clock response is already included in 1-Fprime.

equations.metric: ds²=−(1−2U)dt²+(1+2U)dx², U=m/rplus+m/rminus; curl[(1−2U)Bflux]=0 to first order.
equations.flux: delta nu=epsilon*Sg, Sg=2nu(1/u−1), epsilon=m/d. Fixed charges, no extra point multipoles or imposed field at infinity.
equations.path: delta f/epsilon=integral Sg*K_L ds; point-mouth endpoint work vanishes. b(nu)~−2*C_L/nu at0; b(nu)~−(2−nu) at2.
equations.accounting: 67 already includes the first gravitational optical/Shapiro delay on the reference curves. This adds only the first field-path bending. Varying that O(m/d) optical factor along the O(m/d) displaced path is beyond this first variation, with near-interface matching still separate.
equations.closure: delta w=[Fmag+Fgrav+Cclock*eta+Cthroat*theta]/[1-Fprime]; gravity/current cross terms are not included.

scope: Selected static weak-metric and point-mouth harmonic boundary choice, not a solved two-body Einstein–Maxwell–quantum exterior. Full nonspherical throat response, physical finite-mouth interfaces, independent clock matching, orbital motion, source preparation and finite-q endpoint state remain unresolved. Combined figures are conditional first-order components, not complete physical error bars or dynamical stability. No backward time travel is demonstrated.
sources: https://arxiv.org/html/1903.00223: curved-spacetime Maxwell constitutive equations; not a material recipe.
https://arxiv.org/html/1807.04726v3: magnetic channels and need to support or orbit the two mouths. Bending/state update and sensitivity calculation are ours.
